abilities.desc_en:
Isn't That Just Prime
Optimus Primal hopes for the best, but always prepares for the worst. Damaging Debuffs have shorter durations and recover health when they expire.
Damaging Debuffs expire {{var_1}} faster for each Armor Buff on Optimus Primal. Optimus Primal gains {{var_2}} of his max Health each time a Bleed on him expires.
+about {{var_3}} per level

abilities.desc_zh: 擎天柱升空，为敌人伸张正义。
abilities.desc_en: Law of the Jungle - Optimus Primal launches into the air to bring justice to his foes.

abilities.desc_zh: 如果擎天柱在这场战斗中受到任何流血，他将对造成 {{var_4}} 攻击力超过 {{var_5}} 的对手造成流血。这场战斗中擎天柱每次流血，流血强度都会增加 {{var_6}}。
abilities.desc_en: If Optimus Primal has received any Bleeds this fight he will inflict Bleed on the opponent that deals {{var_4}} of Attack over {{var_5}}. The strength of the Bleed increases by {{var_6}} for each Bleed inflicted on Optimus Primal this fight.

abilities.desc_zh: 最快的和平方法，就是尽快结束战斗。
abilities.desc_en: Beast Warrior - The quickest way to peace, is to end the battle quickly.

abilities.title_zh: 盟友恐龙机器人、犀牛、猎豹
abilities.desc_en: Allies Dinobot, Rhinox, Cheetor- +{{var_13}}~{{var_14}} Armor Rating.

abilities.desc_zh: 每次重击后，该机器人都会获得野兽之怒增益，使攻击有 {{var_17}}~{{var_18}} 机会无法被 {{var_19}} 阻挡。
abilities.desc_en: After each Heavy Attack, this bot gains a Beast Fury buff that grants Attacks a {{var_17}}~{{var_18}} chance to be Unblockable for {{var_19}}.

abilities.desc_zh: 只要 Primal 的队伍中有 2 个或更多野兽战争机器人，野兽战争角色的重击就会为 {{var_22}} 提供 {{var_20}}~{{var_21}} 攻击评级并净化伤害减益。
abilities.desc_en: Heavy Attacks of Beast Wars characters grant {{var_20}}~{{var_21}} Attack Rating for {{var_22}} and Purify Damaging Debuffs as long as there are 2 or more Beast Wars bots on Primal’s team.

abilities.desc_zh: 所有机器人 - 作为团队领导的灯塔，所有较低级别的队友都获得 +{{var_23}} 攻击评级。
abilities.desc_en: All Bots - Acting as a beacon of leadership for the team, all lower tier teammates gain +{{var_23}} Attack Rating.
